collection

Collection of oral histories documenting Chinatown and South End. Oral histories labeled under South End often address individuals and activities in Chinatown. Many of the transcripts of the oral histories are partial and appear to have been edited.

← Back to Collections

Access Policy Notes
Oral history recordings and transcripts have been digitized, along with some other material. The rest of the material is open for research in person through Boston City Archives.
